components.description: Shared Atelier action from main.css plus atelier.css. The home call to action has its own larger padding.
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:'DM Sans','Noto Sans TC','Yu Gothic',system-ui,sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;min-height:44px;border:1px solid var(--accent,#af235e);border-radius:7px;padding:12px 18px;background:var(--accent,#af235e);color:var(--white,#fffdfb);font-size:13px;font-weight:550;line-height:1.6;box-shadow:none;cursor:pointer;transition:transform var(--motion-fast,160ms) var(--ease-out,cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)),background var(--motion-fast,160ms) ease,border-color var(--motion-fast,160ms) ease}.ds-primary:hover{background:#8e184a;border-color:#8e184a;transform:translateY(-2px)}.ds-primary:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px) scale(.99)}.ds-primary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed}.ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#af235e);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}.ds-primary:hover,.ds-primary:active:not(:disabled){transform:none}}

components.name: Studio Stepper
components.description: Three workflow steps with the active pink area and berry baseline. The final step is disabled until a product is selected.
components.css: .ds-steps{font-family:'DM Sans','Noto Sans TC','Yu Gothic',system-ui,sans-serif;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#e9dce4);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;max-width:650px}.ds-step{font-family:'DM Sans','Noto Sans TC','Yu Gothic',system-ui,sans-serif;position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:start;gap:8px;min-height:62px;border:0;border-radius:0;padding:12px 16px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#716071);font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms ease,color 160ms ease,transform 160ms var(--ease-out,cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1))}.ds-step-number{font-size:15px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#87506c;margin-right:3px}.ds-step-current{color:var(--ink,#302236);font-weight:600;background:var(--accent-pink-soft,#fbe0eb)}.ds-step-current:after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-1px;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:var(--accent,#af235e)}.ds-step:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--accent-yellow-soft,#fff1b9)}.ds-step:active:not(:disabled){transform:scale(.98)}.ds-step:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #6d8d9c;outline-offset:3px}.ds-step:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:not-allowed}@media(max-width:430px){.ds-step{flex-direction:column;align-items:start;min-height:80px;padding:10px 9px;gap:2px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-step{transition:none}.ds-step:active:not(:disabled){transform:none}}

narrative.overview:
OOTIE combines an editorial fashion voice with an approachable personal wardrobe. Warm paper, berry actions, generous photography and pastel working areas make the product colorful without sacrificing the clarity of forms and navigation. The Latin serif headlines supply the fashion character; compact sans-serif controls keep the application usable.

The original wardrobe-door opening remains a signature welcome. English is the default, with Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Spanish treated as complete layouts: type size, line height, wrapping and emphasis change with the language. Product photography and editorial imagery retain distinct roles and source labels.
keyCharacteristics: Berry actions on warm paper, with butter yellow, mint, pink and lilac surfaces.
Editorial serif headlines paired with concise sans-serif controls.
Quiet bordered panels, visible garment silhouettes and selective photographic depth.
Locale-aware typography and a reduced-motion alternative to the wardrobe entrance.

rules.name: The Color Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Use the existing pastel families to distinguish working areas; keep the berry treatment for actions, selection and intentional emphasis.

rules.name: The Locale Shapes Type Rule
rules.body: Preserve each locale's wrapping, upright CJK emphasis and expanded line height; do not force translated headings into the English geometry.

rules.name: The Quiet Working Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep forms and browsing panels flat; use depth for photographic composition and floating layers.

dos: **Do** reuse berry actions and the existing pastel surface families to make state and destination legible.
**Do** keep the original wardrobe opening, replay action and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** preserve locale-specific type rules for English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Spanish.
**Do** contain garment and full-body editorial images, and preserve their source or editorial labels.
**Do** keep visible labels, keyboard states, privacy language and actual service status alongside the visual refinement.
donts: **Don't** apply the hero photograph's crop to merchant product images or full-body editorial posts.
**Don't** expand the arched hero silhouette or photographic shadows into every working panel.
**Don't** present prepared editorial posts, private merchant photos or pending jobs as verified customer activity or live YouCam output.
**Don't** use the generated sidecar tonal ramps as new production colors without a deliberate design change.
